description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ImageControllerTest' for testing the 'ImageController' class within the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test fixtures and verifies the behavior of image response handling, including content type, cache headers, ETag validation, and response content size. The tests include simulating HTTP requests and checking proper response attributes and cache validation mechanisms.

classes.name: ImageControllerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ImageController responses related to image serving, headers, and caching.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures by loading theme data from a YAML file before any tests are run.

methods.name: testHandle
methods.description: Runs tests on the handle method of ImageController, verifying headers, cache validation, and content size for different images.

methods.name: dataProviderForController
methods.description: Provides test data sets with image name, expected size, and ETag for parameterized testing.
